title: Titan X Watermelon Ice Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Watermelon Ice is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, ensuring a seamless vaping experience with no messy refills required. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. The Watermelon Ice flavour delivers a fresh, delicately sweet Watermelon taste with a smooth, cooling Menthol finish. The juicy fruit notes are bright yet mellow, while the crisp menthol exhale provides a brisk, clean contrast for a refreshing mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape. Designed for ease and reliability, the Titan X Refill Kit features a pre-installed mesh coil for consistently vivid flavour and smooth vapour. Combined with the Titan X device’s intelligent auto-refill technology, this kit offers up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
